HomePage.title: ROKIO – Process analysis for small and medium businesses
HomePage.description: Employees share their experience, the AI brings it together, the team decides the first step.

Kopf.logoAlt: ROKIO – Finding the right AI and robotics solutions together

Home.titel: Your people know where things get stuck.
Home.einleitung: ROKIO turns that into a feed: swipe cards instead of filling in forms. It shows at which handovers time is lost – and which AI or robotics solution helps exactly there.
Home.codeFrage: Got a code from the notice board?
Home.handyKarte: We built a railing from the old drawing.
Home.schleifeText: What one person reports, the AI turns into an anonymous card. The other teams confirm with one thumb. Every confirmation counts as a voice for exactly this handover.

gesten.kenn: Know it – a voice for this handover
gesten.nicht: Not here – counts as a vote against
gesten.staendig: Happens all the time – frequent and stressful
gesten.halten: Press and hold – tell more, by voice or one sentence

Home.bildText: The handover map shows where time is lost between teams – never who is to blame. Hourly-rate ranges turn “annoying” into a number.
Home.bildZahlText: ≈ {euro} per year in the demo metalworks (fictional)
Home.karteHinweis: Handover map of a fictional metalworking company

metallbau.stimme: We built a railing from the old drawing.
metallbau.loesung: Change agent: a change is said once and is correct everywhere.

pflege.stimme: At handover everyone talks fast and in abbreviations.
pflege.loesung: Handover assistant: in every language, without jargon.

mensa.stimme: Between twelve and two the return belt overflows.
mensa.loesung: Return with eyes: the dish room reports what was overcooked.

Home.vertrauenText: People who are afraid don't swipe honestly. That's why these rules are on the first card, not in the small print.
regeln: Management sees a topic only from three voices.
No individual answers, no names, no timestamps.
Voice becomes text, audio is not stored.
Nobody sees whether or when someone swipes.
In real use, the AI runs locally.
The works council is involved from the start (§ 87 (1) no. 6 BetrVG).
Home.schluss: Give them a reason to say it.
Home.ehrlich: Honestly labelled: maturity and origin are shown for every solution, “checked by ROKI” only with a source. The demo uses fictional companies.

Anlegen.einleitung: Three minutes. Then ROKIO prepares the survey for your business, and you get a code for your team.
Anlegen.name: Business name
Anlegen.leistungen: What does your business do? (one sentence)
Anlegen.leistungenPlatzhalter: e.g. custom stairs and railings, with in-house installation
Anlegen.optional: (optional – ROKIO reads it to prepare suitable questions)
Anlegen.zielPlatzhalter: e.g. Less rush before we hire new people
Anlegen.anrede: How do we address your team?
Anlegen.bereicheHinweis: A rough range for each area: What does one working hour cost the business? No individual wages – only used to convert lost time into euros.
Anlegen.deadline: When and where will you discuss the results with everyone?
Anlegen.deadlinePlatzhalter: e.g. Thu, 3 December, 7:30 am in the workshop
Anlegen.deadlineHinweis: Every person sees this in the survey. It is your commitment that something will happen with the answers.
Anlegen.lernt: ROKIO is getting to know your business and preparing the questions …
Anlegen.chipsMitWebsite: Prepared from your input and your website. Tap to remove, add your own.
Anlegen.chipsOhneWebsite: Prepared from your input. Tap to remove, add your own.
Anlegen.chipsErsatz: The AI was not available just now – these are general suggestions. Please adjust.
